name: Tiling and tessellation
definition: A tiling covers a region with copies of a shape, no gaps and no overlaps. Questions ask how many tiles fit, whether a given shape can tile at all, or what the pattern looks like further along. Area gives a quick necessary check but never a sufficient one.
recognizeWhen: cover the floor with these tiles
the pattern continues in all directions
can the shape be tiled without gaps
how many tiles are needed to cover
misconceptions: I divided the areas and assumed the tiles would therefore fit.
I forgot that the tiles could be rotated.
I allowed tiles to hang over the edge of the region.
